description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1679/16 of 09.11.2010, Moratuwa D/S DIvision - Cad. Map No. 520210
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the amendment of land title registration for a particular parcel of land (No. 8 of Block 16) in the Cadastral Map, including changes to the parcel number and land extent. It falls under the Commissioner of Title Settlement's authority and is published in the "PART III - LANDS" section, making it clearly a land and property-related matter that fits the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
